title: Capability Library V1 (what GET /api/capabilities answers)
$comment: Written against the 60-record payload the product emitted on 2026-10-08 (46 sources from vendor/sources.lock.json + 14 models from design-lab/readiness/model-radar.json), captured through design_lab.http_service.make_server on a live socket; see design-lab/scripts/verify_route_payload_contracts.py. Emitter: src/design_lab/analysis/capability_library.py:247 (SCHEMA_VERSION at line 26). Every capability record carries the same 26 keys whichever kind it is, so `required` names all 26 and the document is closed. WHERE A VOCABULARY COMES FROM IS RECORDED HONESTLY: `kind` and `revisionState` are the emitter's own words and are enumerated; `disposition`, `presence`, `license`, `sourceType` and `evidenceLevel` are passed through from the committed records (design-lab/schemas/source-record.schema.json and readiness-model-radar.schema.json own them), so they are typed here and not frozen into an enum the projection does not control. `qualified` and `qualificationEvidence` were const null until 2026-10-10: that was honest for the payload this schema was written against, and it became a contract that forbade the DL-FINAL-T06 read-back, which returns a recorded boolean and a real evidence list. They are now typed, and null still means there is no qualification recorded rather than false or 0; qualification remains a host run plus a human acceptance, neither of which a registry can yield. `axes` carries the per-axis values the taxonomy holds (null, a list of strings, or an object), which is the same passthrough T06 asks for.

domains.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

artifactTypes.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

capabilityLayers.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

aestheticAxes.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

styleArchetypes.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

tier.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

designQuality.description: declared taxonomy values for this axis, or null when the axis is unclassified for this record

axisValues.description: CLASSIFICATION_AXES (capability_library.py:35) carried per record: DL-FINAL-T06 asks for the values, not just the names of the axes that are empty.

axisList.description: A subset of CLASSIFICATION_AXES (capability_library.py:35): the axes the taxonomy declares but no observed candidate has filled.

qualified.description: null means no qualification recorded, not false and not 0; true or false only when a recorded verdict exists

qualificationReason.description: why there is no verdict yet; null once a recorded verdict exists

allOf.$comment: revisionState is derived, not declared: VERIFIED only when the vendor revision record pinned this exact identity, UNRESOLVED only when the record lists it as unresolved. A source with neither is NOT_VERIFIED -- never 'no provenance'.
